By Default Design System v7.3.0

Styleguide

Every framework primitive on one page, rendered by the packaged design-system-core.css. The values you see are the neutral engine defaults. To preview a brand, place a theme.css beside this file and reload. Components that need JavaScript at runtime are shown in fixed states and say so.

Type

Your primary headline, big, bold, and unmissable

Supporting headline to guide your content

Type with purpose, design with intent

Smaller subheading for detailed content organisation

Clear navigation heading for important information
Strategic headline for critical content sections

An eyebrow labels the section above a heading

This paragraph demonstrates how body text looks across your layout. Bold text adds emphasis, while italics offer a subtle highlight. You can also use strikethrough to show edits, or an inline link for navigation. A full paragraph like this one is the fastest way to judge readability, measure, and rhythm against a brand's type choices.

.text-size-xl

Lead paragraph text for hero sections and introductions.

.text-size-l

Introductory text that sits between headings and body.

.text-size-m

The default body size, stated explicitly.

.text-size-s

Smaller supporting text for secondary information.

.text-size-xs

Captions, metadata, and fine print.

Words matter, but how those words are presented matters just as much. Typography transforms content from mundane to magical.

Lists

  • Unordered lists organise related items without hierarchy
  • Ideal for features, benefits, or options
    • Nested items indent one level
    • Across light and dark surfaces
  • Keep items concise and parallel in structure
  1. Use headings to create a visual hierarchy
  2. Structure content with clear lists
  3. Guide readers step by step with ordered items
  • A checklist item, done
  • A checklist item, open

Buttons

Base class .button, variation via data-* attributes, state via .is-* classes. A bare <button> is a reset only.

What does the framework ship?

One CSS file, an icon sprite, and neutral engine defaults on real token names. Brand values arrive through your project's theme.css.
